record_title: Exact Chernoff envelopes for heterogeneous Bernoulli randomization
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Independent Bernoulli assignments and known deterministic potential-outcome bounds are required. Midpoint optimality is for the two-sided cgf envelope within the unitwise-centered Horvitz--Thompson family, not all unbiased estimators. Exactness concerns the worst-case cgf, not exact tails or shortest confidence intervals. The closed-form Bernstein specialization is not outcome-adaptive. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from older Poisson-sampling and survey-sampling concentration literature.
